title: Game definition loading from room creation API
description: Server currently auto-creates rooms with a hardcoded placeholder definition. Add an HTTP endpoint or WebSocket message to create a room with a specific game definition (JSON body or URI reference). Validate definition before creating room. Remove the auto-create fallback.
close_reason: Added POST /rooms endpoint that accepts full game definition JSON, validates via engine, and creates room. Added GET /rooms to list active rooms. Removed auto-create fallback — WebSocket handler now returns 404 for nonexistent rooms. Client resolves definition URLs and POSTs the JSON.
